# Claude Code Environment Variables: Auth

These 77 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover API keys, login tokens, and credential helpers.
They decide who Claude Code says you are when it talks to a model.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...` before `claude` to use an API key instead of a login.
Or put `{ "env": { "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-..." } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).

| Name | Mark | What It Does | Value | Where It Works |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | ✅ | Sets the API key that Claude Code sends to the API. It takes precedence over a profile sign-in. | Text | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` | ✅ | Sets the `Authorization` header to `Bearer` plus the value. Also counts as a credential for gateway model discovery. | Text. Read on each access | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY` | ✅ | Workspace API key for Claude Platform on AWS. When it is set, Claude Code skips the AWS credential chain for that client. | Text. Code removes it for a moment while it builds a client that uses the AWS chain | Provider `anthropicAws`. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR` | ✅ | Sets the directory for Anthropic profile files. Claude Code reads `configs` and `credentials` files from it. | Text. Wins over `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. Unused when a helper returns null for the current mode | Profile and federation sign-in, all. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID` | ✅ | Federation rule ID for workload identity federation. With `ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID` it selects the `env-quad` federation credential. | Text. `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` is an optional third value | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY` | ✅ | API key for Microsoft Foundry. When it is set, Claude Code does not build the Azure default credential. | Text. The Foundry client reads the key. `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN` wins over it | Provider `foundry`. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN` | ✅ | Bearer token for Microsoft Foundry. It wins over the API key and over the Azure default credential. | Text. The token provider returns it on each request | Provider `foundry`. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN` | ✅ | The bundled SDK uses it as the OIDC identity token for workload identity federation when no config file gives one. | Text. Used with `ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID` and `ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID`. Also in a list of secret-like env names | Bundled SDK federation sign-in. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE` | ✅ | The bundled SDK reads the OIDC identity token from this file path for workload identity federation. | Text. Becomes `identity_token` with source `file`. Used when the org ID and rule ID are set and no config file exists | Bundled SDK federation sign-in. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID` | ✅ | Organization ID for workload identity federation. Set it with `ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID`. | Text. Together they form the `env-quad` federation identity. The SDK also reads it as a fallback | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_PROFILE` | ✅ | Names the Anthropic profile to sign in with. | Text, profile by default. An explicit value makes the profile mode `profile-explicit` | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_SCOPE` | 🔍 | The bundled SDK sends it as the OAuth `scope` in workload identity federation. A config file value wins. | Text. Fills `authentication.scope` when the config does not set it | Bundled SDK federation sign-in. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID` | 🔍 | The bundled SDK uses it as `service_account_id` in workload identity federation. | Text. Fills `authentication.service_account_id` when the config does not set it | Bundled SDK federation sign-in. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` | ✅ | Workspace ID for workload identity federation. It is optional in the `env-quad` identity. | Text. The SDK also reads it as a fallback | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` | ✅ | Amazon Bedrock API key. Claude Code sends it as a `Bearer` token and skips the AWS credential chain. | Text. Used for Bedrock and Mantle clients | Providers `bedrock` and `mantle`. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_AUTH_SNAPSHOT_PATH` | 🔍 | Points to a JSON file with a gateway token or access token for a background session. | Text. Claude Code reads the file once, deletes the file, and removes the var. Retries if the file is busy | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_CLAIM_AUTH` | 🔍 | Carries the claim token for a spare background session. | Text. A tokens file can replace it | Spare background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_RATE_LIMIT_TIER` | 🔍 | Passes the rate limit tier of the dispatcher account to a background session. | Text. Used only when `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND` is `bg`. The dispatcher sets it | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE` | 🔍 | Passes the subscription type of the dispatcher account to a background session. | Text. Used only when `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND` is `bg`. The dispatcher sets it | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_PTY_AUTH` | 🔍 | Holds the shared secret for the PTY link of a background session. | Text. Claude Code generates and sets it. It is removed from child env in exec mode | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_RV_AUTH` | 🔍 | Holds the shared secret for the rendezvous socket of a background session. | Text. Claude Code sets it. The session reads it once and deletes it | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_SOCKET_TOKENS_PATH` | 🔍 | Points to a tokens file with the rendezvous and claim secrets for a background session. | Text. Claude Code reads the file once, deletes the file, and removes the var | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BRIDGE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | 🔍❌ | In the schema, but nothing reads it. The name appears only in string lists of host-controlled or credential names. | Text | Remote bridge. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID` | ✅ | Gives the account UUID when the host supplies the account. It fills account info and telemetry ids. | Text. With `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL` and `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` it builds the account record in some host modes | Host-managed and SDK sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_FILE_DESCRIPTOR` | 🔍 | Names a file descriptor from which Claude Code reads the API key at startup. | A number. A reader function runs at startup when it is set. The debug auth dump shows if it is set | SDK and host launches. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS` | ✅ | Sets how often Claude Code refreshes credentials from `apiKeyHelper`. | A number of milliseconds, stays by default. Whole number of `0` or more. A negative value logs an error and the built-in default stays | All sessions with `apiKeyHelper`. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACTS_API_TOKEN` | 🔍 | Gives a bearer token for requests to the artifacts frame host. | Text. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer` plus the value, only when the frame host mode is active | Artifacts frame requests. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTH_FAIL_EXIT_MS` | 🔍 | Makes a remote child session exit when an OAuth 401 stays unrecovered for this long. The runner then restarts it with fresh credentials. | A number of milliseconds, `600000` by default. Whole number, minimum `0`. A value of `0` turns the exit off | Remote child sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CUSTOM_OAUTH_URL` | 🔍 | Replaces the OAuth base URL and endpoints with a custom host. Throws if the URL is not on the approved endpoint list. | Text. A trailing slash is removed. Only fedstart style hosts pass the check | All sessions, first-party auth |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DESIGN_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | 🔍 | Sets the OAuth client id for Claude Design login. A build without a registered client shows an error that asks for this variable. | Text. A value starting with `00000000-` counts as unset | Claude Design login |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTH_REFRESH_LOCK` | ✅ | Makes each process run `gcpAuthRefresh` or `awsAuthRefresh` itself without the cross-process lock. | On or off. Code gates the auth refresh lock on its negation | Bedrock and Vertex with auth refresh |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER` | 🔍 | Turns on the `proxyAuthHelper` setting so a helper command can mint proxy auth headers. | On or off, off by default. Cache TTL comes from `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER_TTL_MS`, default `300000` | Proxy setups |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_XAA` | 🔍 | Turns on XAA for MCP OAuth and unlocks the `xaaIdp` setting. | On or off, off by default. Without it, MCP OAuth with `oauth.xaa` fails with `XAA is not enabled` | MCP OAuth |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FEDERATION_CACHE_DIR` | 🔍 | Sets the directory for the workload identity federation token cache. | Text. Default is a `credentials/federation` folder in the config dir | Federated auth, eval harness copies it |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_WINDOWS_CREDMAN` | 🔍🧪 | Forces the Windows Credential Manager path on when set to `1`. | Text. Else the cached a feature flag decides | Windows |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_TOKEN` | 🔍❌ | Nothing reads it in 2.1.303. | Text. `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR` is the live name | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR` | 🔍 | Reads the gateway token from this open file descriptor, then removes the var from the env. | A number. Ignored with `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE` or an IPC channel | Hosts that spawn Claude Code |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HFI_BEARER_TOKEN` | 🔍 | The name appears only in a list of env names and the schema has it as a `str`. Nothing reads it, and a [Probes](Claude-Code-Probes) run saw no effect. | Text | All sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR` | 🔍 | Names the env var that holds the credential a host app supplies. Its presence counts as host-managed auth. | Text. Reserved names are skipped. Removed from some child envs | Host apps that embed Claude Code |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS` | 🔍 | Passes a timeout to the request that asks the SDK host to refresh the auth token. | A number of milliseconds. Used only when `CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH` is set. An invalid value means no timeout | SDK host, stream-json print mode |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_CREDS_FILE` | 🔍 | Names a credentials file that a host app owns. Claude Code tests paths against it and adds it to a path list built with the sandbox rules. | Text. Also turns on the gateway lineage check together with `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_GATEWAY_LINEAGE`. Its name is kept from children | Host apps with a gateway |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_GATEWAY_LINEAGE` | 🔍 | Marks a session as gateway-managed by the host. It counts only when `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_CREDS_FILE` is also set. | On or off. Claude Code sets it to `1` for child processes when its lineage check passes. It is removed in other child envs | Host apps with a gateway, set by Claude Code |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_401_WAIT_MS` | 🔍 | A helper returns this value, or a built-in value for remote runner children, or `0`. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | A number of milliseconds, `0` by default. Whole number min `0` | Remote runners, OAuth |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | 🔍 | Overrides the OAuth client id for login and for refresh-token login. | Text. When set it also clears the registered plugin and project scope flags | All sessions, OAuth |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN` | ✅ | Lets `claude auth login` exchange a refresh token with no browser. Needs `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`. | Text. Startup stops with an error when the scopes are missing. A used token cannot be reused | `claude auth login` |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES` | ✅ | Gives the scopes that the refresh token was issued with. It also sets the scopes of `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. | Text, scope by default. Docs mention only the refresh token use | All sessions, OAuth |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | ✅ | Gives an OAuth access token for claude.ai auth that wins over stored login. | Text. Counts as an auth source. Dropped from shell child envs | All sessions, SDK and automation |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR` | 🔍 | Counts as an OAuth token source like `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. The code shown only tests that it is set. | Text. Remote sessions print `set` or `unset` for it in an error message | All sessions, remote sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` | 🔍 | Sets the organization UUID. Sent as `X-Organization-Uuid` with a `sk-ant-sid` session key and used as the org ID before the OAuth profile lookup. | Text. With `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID` and `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL` it builds the `oauthAccount`. A self-hosted runner passes it to sessions | All sessions, mostly cloud and runner sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER_TTL_MS` | 🔍 | Sets the time-to-live of the proxy auth helper result. The helper itself needs `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER`. | A number of milliseconds, constant by default. Whole number in ms of 0 or more. Negative or unset gives an internal default constant | All sessions, when the proxy auth helper is on |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_TIER` | 🔍 | Gives the rate limit tier for a token from `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. | Text. Set by Claude Code from a background auth snapshot. Used with `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE` | Sessions using an env OAuth token |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH` | 🔍 | Tells Claude Code that the SDK host can refresh host auth tokens. Claude Code then asks the host for a new token when needed. | Set by Claude Code in the SDK child env to `1` when the host supports it. The wait uses `CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS` | SDK and print mode. Set by Claude Code |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SDK_HAS_OAUTH_REFRESH` | 🔍 | Tells Claude Code that the SDK host can refresh the OAuth token. Claude Code then requests a refresh from the host. | Set by Claude Code in the SDK child env to `1` when the host supports it. It takes effect only for some entrypoints | SDK and print mode. Set by Claude Code |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ACCESS_TOKEN` | ✅ | Holds the session access token for remote sessions. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, or as a cookie when it starts with `sk-ant-sid`. | Text. Falls back to the token file | Remote and ingress sessions. Set by Claude Code on refresh |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE` | 🔍 | Gives the subscription type for a token supplied through `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Claude Code also sets it from a background auth snapshot. | Text. It is used with `CLAUDE_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_TIER` | OAuth token auth and background sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL` | 🔍 | Supplies the account email when a host passes the account by env. It is also used as `user.email` in telemetry and in the user context. | Text. Account use needs `CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID` and `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` too | SDK hosts and remote runs |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBSOCKET_AUTH_FILE_DESCRIPTOR` | 🔍 | Names a file descriptor that holds the WebSocket session token. Claude Code reads the token at startup. | Text. Read next to the API key and gateway descriptor reads | Remote and SDK URL sessions |
| `CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_API_BASE` | 🔍 | Sets the API base URL in the local OAuth config. | Text, `http` by default. Trailing slash removed | Local OAuth config |
| `CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_APPS_BASE` | 🔍 | Sets the claude.ai origin and authorize URL in the local OAuth config. | Text, `http` by default. Trailing slash removed | Local OAuth config |
| `CLAUDE_LOCAL_OAUTH_CONSOLE_BASE` | 🔍 | Sets the console authorize URL in the local OAuth config. | Text, `http` by default. Trailing slash removed | Local OAuth config |
| `CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR` | 🔍 | Overrides the config directory that names the secure-storage credentials entry. | A path | - |
| `CLAUDE_SESSION_INGRESS_TOKEN_FILE` | ✅ | Sets the path of the file that holds the session ingress token. A set value also makes the entrypoint `remote`. | A path | - |
| `CLAUDE_TRUSTED_DEVICE_TOKEN` | 🔍 | Supplies the trusted device token. It wins over the stored token and stops trusted-device enrollment. | Text (a secret) | - |
| `DISABLE_LOGIN_COMMAND` | ✅ | Hides the `/login` command. | On or off | - |
| `DISABLE_LOGOUT_COMMAND` | ✅ | Hides the `/logout` command. | On or off | - |
| `ENVIRONMENT_SERVICE_KEY` | 🔍 | It appears in a list of secret-like names next to other token names. No property read of this name was found. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | Text | Unknown |
| `GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` | ✅ | Token for a GitHub Enterprise host. Used when `GH_HOST` names that host. Claude Code blanks it when it runs `gh`. | Text. The scrub list was not checked | GitHub features. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `GH_TOKEN` | ✅ | Token for github.com. Claude Code uses it first for GitHub API calls and blanks it when it runs `gh`. | Text. The scrub list was not checked | GitHub features. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` | ✅ | Second name for the GitHub Enterprise token, after `GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN`. Claude Code blanks it when it runs `gh`. | Text. The scrub list was not checked | GitHub features. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | ✅ | Second name for the github.com token, after `GH_TOKEN`. Claude Code blanks it when it runs `gh`. | Text. The scrub list was not checked | GitHub features. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `MCP_CLIENT_SECRET` | ✅ | Gives the OAuth client secret for MCP servers with pre-set credentials, without a prompt. | Text (a secret) | - |
| `MCP_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT` | ✅ | Fixes the port of the MCP OAuth redirect callback. | A number | - |
| `MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_URL` | 🔍 | Overrides the OAuth client metadata document URL that MCP OAuth uses. | A URL | - |

| `USE_LOCAL_OAUTH` | 🔍 | Points OAuth and bridge URLs at a local server. It switches the bridge to `ws://localhost:8765` and trusts localhost hosts. | On or off. Used in a dev OAuth and bridge setup. Not for normal use | All sessions, development only |
| `USE_STAGING_OAUTH` | 🔍 | Points OAuth and bridge URLs at staging. The bridge uses `wss://bridge-staging.claudeusercontent.com`. | On or off. Claude Code sets it to `1` for remote sessions when the `api_base_url` contains `staging` | All sessions, set by Claude Code for staging cloud |
